name: ACTi Corporation
summary: ACTi Corporation operates as a global provider of advanced video surveillance solutions. The company offers an extensive range of cameras, including traditional analog models, high-resolution and high-frame-rate units, versatile pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) and panoramic cameras, and specialized options such as AI-powered and covert cameras, alongside those designed to meet specific certifications. They also supply various camera selection tools and intelligent analytics cameras for applications like people counting, face analysis, and automatic license plate recognition (ALPR). Beyond their camera offerings, ACTi delivers comprehensive video management solutions. This includes standalone Network Video Recorders (NVRs), sophisticated software platforms, and central management systems. The company provides video encoders and decoders, complemented by robust system health management tools that monitor the operational status of cameras, NVRs, and other critical infrastructure components. Additionally, they supply digital signage devices capable of decoding and displaying video streams from their surveillance hardware. To support these systems, ACTi offers a full suite of accessories. This encompasses diverse mounting hardware like camera mounts, housings, and dome covers; network and storage peripherals, such as extended storage devices, Power over Ethernet (PoE) data switches, and hard drives; power supply accessories, including PoE injectors and power adapters; and other essential items like camera installation kits and controllers. Their products cater to a broad spectrum of markets, including banking, education, commercial buildings, manufacturing, municipal and government sectors, healthcare, hotels and casinos, parking facilities, residential areas, restaurants, retail, stadiums, transportation, and utilities. Established in 1992, ACTi Corporation is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
